## Aspect: security
IMPORTANT | src/cli.js:20 | confidence 8/10 | Evidence: `runCli` appends every stdin chunk to `chunks`, then concatenates and parses the entire input at lines 20–22, with no size limit. | Impact: An oversized input can consume unbounded memory and cause the CLI process to run out of memory. | Fix: Enforce a maximum input size while reading; reject oversized input with the documented error behavior.

# Code Review Report

## Summary
- Policy: reviewer-readonly-v1
- Perspectives: conventions, bugs, architecture, tests, security
- Files reviewed: 0 (consume mode; findings supplied in the review packet)
- Findings: 3 (0 critical, 2 important, 1 suggestion)
- Verdict: PASS WITH SUGGESTIONS
- Directive: **Fix round required** for the two IMPORTANT findings before merge. No mutations performed.

## Main-Thread Evidence
- Tests: Packet reports full `npm test` and lint runs exited 0; scoped docs-and-checks checkpoint passed; acceptance status was 4/4 active criteria pass.
- Build: Packet reports `npm run build` exited 0 and printed `Build passed: src copied into dist`.
- Coverage: Packet reports `npm run coverage` passed; `src/cli.js` and `src/index.js` each have 100.00% lines, branches, and functions.

## Critical Issues
None.

## Important Issues

### R1-F2 — `src/cli.js:18`
**Evidence:** `runCli` collects all stdin chunks and concatenates the entire document before parsing without a size bound. Impact: an oversized input can exhaust process memory.  
**Fix:** Impose and document a reasonable byte limit and return the required concise invalid-input error and exit 2.

### R1-F1 — `tests/cli.test.js:25`
**Evidence:** `runProcess` starts `src/cli.js` directly, while `package.json` exposes `dist/cli.js` through the `invoice-quote` bin; the durable suite has no test that builds, packs, installs, and runs that package bin. Impact: a packaging/bin regression could escape the test suite even though this exact built package passed the current live acceptance run.  
**Fix:** Add a disposable offline package-consumer test covering successful output and invalid-input exit behavior.

## Suggestions

### R1-F3 — `package.json:4`
**Evidence:** README documents Node.js >=22, while `package.json` contains no `engines.node` field. Impact: package managers cannot warn consumers below the supported runtime.  
**Fix:** Add `engines.node >=22`.

findings.title: Hook-injected shell bindings are mistaken for forbidden model-authored overrides
findings.observation: Seven successful native context/policy probes preceded tdd-begin. Copilot repeatedly described the automatically added selector export prefix as its own mistake. The run recovered without intervention. After closure a command carrying the context marker without bound exports was refused as Malformed session binding; the model retried with the valid bound command and recovered.
findings.recommendation: Document the exact hook-generated prefix and its provenance in model-visible instructions; instruct the model to submit only the original command and accept successful results without replaying or removing the hook prefix.

findings.title: Review file enumeration refers to a removed procedure
findings.observation: Review-chain and self-review instructions require the Phase6 step5b(b) enumeration unchanged, while current audit5b(b) contains verdict handling after enumeration moved into a helper.
findings.recommendation: Provide one canonical change-set helper/output contract and reference it directly from review and self-review, including untracked and mid-run-committed files.
findings.crossPluginEvidence: Exact stale reference also exists in tracked upstream/zensu-claude-code/skills/tdd/references/review-chain.md:7 and skills/self-review/SKILL.md:44,107. Other installed plugins were not inspected.

findings.title: Unlanded-edit recovery instructions contradict the evidence helper
findings.observation: Review-chain says to land the edit or withdraw the claim and rerun. Audit instructions and helper say a withdrawn claim cannot clear the failed receipt.
findings.recommendation: Align recovery instructions with the actual grader: land and re-audit, or explicitly preserve failure and start a properly authorized fresh generation when the claim cannot be satisfied.
findings.crossPluginEvidence: Same contradictory text exists in the tracked upstream workflow references. This branch was not exercised in this live test.

findings.title: Documentation advertises external review imports not shipped by the native port
findings.observation: modes.md mentions external-review imports and configuration.md documents the external-review helper, while native review-chain docs say the helper/templates do not ship.
findings.recommendation: Remove unsupported import instructions or clearly mark them as unavailable; keep native agent review as the single supported execution path.
findings.crossPluginEvidence: Port-specific stale documentation inherited from an upstream feature; no runtime compatibility layer observed.

findings.scope: Shared skill structure; Copilot read limit observed
findings.title: Oversized verification skill cannot be read in one native view call
findings.observation: Native view call_mKS5YwujO4FKSYDfM6aMaaic at 2026-10-19T18:10:52.908Z returned success=true but no content: File too large to read at once (44.1 KB). Copilot recovered with view_range. Native entrypoint is45120bytes/585lines; tracked upstream counterpart40221bytes/568lines.
findings.recommendation: Split verification into a compact safety/driver-selection entrypoint and bounded references per driver, lifecycle and chain recording. Explicitly handle content-limit responses even when the transport reports success.
findings.crossPluginEvidence: Large monolithic skill is also present upstream; only Copilot read-limit behavior and recovery were live-tested.

findings.title: Synthetic local acceptance runs suppress all assertion diagnostics
findings.observation: All four exit-code acceptance commands redirected stdout and stderr to /dev/null. AC004 combined tests, lint, build, coverage and a documentation check without retaining which assertion would fail. The commands passed; a failing diagnostic-loss case was not exercised.
findings.recommendation: Retain credential-blind handling for raw application/network output while allowing bounded synthetic diagnostics such as criterion ID, check name, exit code and sanitized assertion category. Do not remove suppression globally.
findings.crossPluginEvidence: Same blanket output-suppression rule exists in the tracked upstream snapshot. Other installed plugins and standalone Zensu CLI were not tested.

findings.title: Required execution and progress markers are not maintained reliably
findings.observation: Copilot armed the native vanilla chain before edits but omitted the separate EXECUTION STARTED log marker. It explicitly disclosed the omission in the review packet rather than backdating it. Real tests, CHECKPOINT and audit evidence are present. At the end, the separate progress checklist still marked Phase 6 audit and Review chain unchecked/in progress, despite successful terminal state and final report.
findings.recommendation: Have a structured implementation-start helper emit the required marker and relevant metadata automatically instead of relying on a separate model-authored ceremonial log line. Reconcile the final progress checklist from completed native stage evidence at chain close, so it cannot contradict the final report.
findings.crossPluginEvidence: Native contract and this live run only; no claim of missing tests or skipped hard gates.

findings.title: Manually duplicated review packets drifted despite an identical-bytes contract
findings.observation: The conventions reviewer packet has one extra leading space before diff_summary; the other four do not. The evidence was semantically equal, but not byte-for-byte identical as required.
findings.recommendation: Generate a canonical immutable evidence packet with a content hash/reference, validate each dispatch against it, and keep reviewer-specific perspective outside that packet.
findings.crossPluginEvidence: Observed in Copilot; shared manual-packet design may benefit from the same helper, but other hosts were not tested.

findings.scope: Shared review contract and completion reliability
findings.title: Primary judge rejected valid evidence and the workflow continued without substantive primary review
findings.observation: Primary judge call_q2JCilMZlZt3pdBc23uswzt3 rejected the actual EDIT LANDING AUDIT terminal summary as a missing close marker. The independent second judge accepted identical evidence. Main logged the primary as unavailable and advanced to consume review; completing the requested whole chain required an explicit same-session recovery intervention.
findings.recommendation: Define and validate the edit-landing receipt/summary schema deterministically before dispatch. Make primary-judge completion an explicit required stage or return a clearly partial result; an additive second judge must not silently substitute for it. Provide bounded retry with preserved original evidence.
findings.crossPluginEvidence: Ambiguous close-marker wording also exists in the tracked upstream agent. Failure/recovery behavior was tested only in Copilot.

findings.title: Quoted heredoc delimiter collided with the required FINDINGS payload marker
findings.observation: The first finding verifier command used FINDINGS as both shell heredoc delimiter and payload section marker. The heredoc ended early; remaining finding lines were attempted as shell commands. Exit127 and total0 instead of3 were correctly recorded as DEGRADED, followed by manual source verification. No harmful command ran.
findings.recommendation: Accept a structured packet file/JSON input through a canonical helper. If heredocs remain, require a generated delimiter absent from the complete payload and validate the summary count before accepting the run. A quoted delimiter alone does not prevent delimiter collisions.
findings.crossPluginEvidence: Same quoted-heredoc/marker-form instructions exist in the tracked upstream reference. The actual model-generated collision was observed in Copilot only.

findings.title: Reviewer fix directive contradicts effective critical-only convergence policy
findings.observation: The consume reviewer reported 2 IMPORTANT and 1 SUGGESTION, labeled PASS WITH SUGGESTIONS, and added Fix round required. The authoritative appended hook guidance correctly resolved hooks.autoFixSeverity=critical and instructed parking IMPORTANT findings before terminal self-review. Self-review then fixed the two IMPORTANT findings in its permitted single round, without another reviewer, as its contract explicitly requires. The model-authored directive and effective routing were inconsistent. The main-agent consume prompt explicitly requested a PASS/fix-round directive but omitted the effective severity policy; the extra Directive section is not prescribed by the reviewer output template.
findings.recommendation: Give the consume reviewer the effective severity/convergence decision and derive its verdict and next-action text from that same decision. Keep any required terminal self-review correction distinct from a routed panel re-review.
findings.crossPluginEvidence: The verdict rubric is shared with the tracked upstream agent; the conflicting extra directive was model-authored in this Copilot run. No missing second panel is alleged for this configured branch.

findings.title: Identical package acceptance suite reruns once per criterion despite reusable evidence
findings.observation: Final AC-001, AC-002 and AC-003 each reran the same package consumer suite on tree c6af75c8900f, rebuilding, packing and installing the unchanged package three times. Each run was valid. The recorder permits one current acceptance-scope record to support multiple AC verdicts, with criterion-specific observations.
findings.recommendation: Document a shared-run pattern: run the suite once, then immediately record each explicitly covered AC separately with the same evidence-run reference. Preserve exact assertion-to-criterion mapping and freshness checks.
findings.crossPluginEvidence: Observed in Copilot and grounded in its recorder contract. A reusable pattern may help other plugins or CLI workflows; those executions were not tested.

findings.title: Self-review skill is reinvoked after successful chain closure
findings.observation: The native self-review skill loaded at 18:29:07Z, again before close at 18:35:53Z, and after successful chain-done at 18:36:49Z. No intervening user message or stop directive requested the post-close invocation. The model then repeated helper/status discovery, including one malformed-binding refusal and oversized search output. The protected chain stayed closed and no additional source edit occurred. Final summary eventually arrived at 18:39:52Z, about 3m17s after successful close.
findings.recommendation: Add an explicit completed-generation fast path: verify the bound closed chain once, render the existing final evidence and remaining findings, and do not restart review discovery or mutation. Return a clear terminal/report-only result from chain-done.
findings.crossPluginEvidence: Model-generated native reinvocation observed only in Copilot. A completed-generation guard is a candidate shared-workflow improvement; no equivalent live failure is asserted for other hosts.

## Problem

## How I built it
Vanilla implementation; round-one review outcome was suggestions-only, with 2 IMPORTANT findings and 1 SUGGESTION across 8 changed files; assisted recovery retained the initial invalid primary-judge attempt and total=0 verifier failure, then recorded a substantive judge retry and successful 3-finding verification.

## TL;DR
The invoice quote library and CLI passed all four acceptance criteria and the final suite; the ticket-bound chain is closed, with one deferred suggestion and the requested post-fix consume-review round unverified.

AC-002.criterion: Validate the input domain, apply half-up basis-point discounts, reject inexact unsafe subtotals, preserve formatCents.
AC-002.evidence: The final packed consumer rejected invalid values and over-limit subtotals, verified half-up rounding and the exact safe boundary, and preserved formatCents output.

AC-003.criterion: Provide the JSON stdin CLI with clean status/output behavior and a working `invoice-quote` executable from a built package in a separate consumer.
AC-003.evidence: The final offline-installed package bin produced the exact quote and exit 0, defaulted an omitted discount, and returned exit 2 with empty stdout and concise stderr for invalid JSON.

AC-001.criterion: Export quoteInvoice with exact result shape and example arithmetic; handle empty items and do not mutate even frozen inputs.
AC-001.evidence: Built, packed, and installed the final package offline in a temporary consumer; its exported quoteInvoice returned the specified object, empty quote, exact keys, and preserved frozen items.

AC-004.criterion: Add meaningful unit and process tests, preserve baseline tests, pass canonical checks and at least 90% source coverage, and document API/CLI examples.
AC-004.evidence: The final-tree canonical test suite, lint, build, and coverage commands passed; README assertions confirmed the API, CLI, and specified example are documented.

harnessNotes: The recovery prompt initially requested a second panel. Source inspection established that critical-only routing instead requires a single terminal self-review fix without another reviewer; the actual path conforms to that contract.

The final Copilot summary labels the requested post-fix consume review a process gap. That refers to the overconstrained recovery prompt, not to a missing required native stage; the configured self-review contract explicitly forbids that rerun.
An attempted resume used the new-session-only --name flag and was rejected before model execution; the launcher was corrected. This is a harness error, not a plugin finding.
Parent-directory instruction reads outside the allowed path were denied. The run continued inside its disposable project.
The original interrupted CLI process returned exit 0 with an unfinished chain. Completion was assessed from native stages, current-tree evidence and terminal state, not exit code alone.
